from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    background, foreground = counts.most_common(2)[0][0], counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    return [[0 if cell == background else background if cell == foreground else cell
             for cell in row] for row in grid]
